elevation-church-charlotte-nc.assessment: Elevation Church is a megachurch (17,000+ weekly attendance, 20 campuses) led by Steven Furtick. SBC-affiliated but operates independently with minimal denominational accountability. Furtick is controversial: prosperity-adjacent theology, celebrity pastor model, modalist-leaning statements on the Trinity (2014 controversy), heavy emphasis on vision-casting over expository preaching. Topical/motivational preaching style. No men's discipleship emphasis found. Address in data (1 Elevation Way, Matthews) is correct for HQ. Massive online presence. Theologically, this is a YELLOW-to-RED church depending on the rubric — entertainment-driven worship, weak on doctrinal precision, personality cult around Furtick.

elizabethtown-bic-pa.assessment: Elizabethtown Brethren in Christ Church is a mid-sized BIC congregation (300-500 attendance) in the eastern Lancaster County town of Elizabethtown. Pastor Adam Forry — previously at Speedwell Heights BIC in Lititz — leads this Atlantic Conference congregation. The BIC tradition is Anabaptist-Wesleyan hybrid: peace witness and Holiness soteriology together, producing mission-minded congregations with synergistic rather than monergistic soteriology. For an Elizabethtown-area man wanting a settled, mid-sized BIC congregation under male senior leadership, Etown BIC is worth a visit. Denominational gender yellow remains structurally.
